item.title: Sanofi Tzield and FDA Political Interference
item.description:
• Summary: Sanofi has requested the removal of Tzield (teplizumab) from a U.S. program amid reports of political interference involving HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. The FDA's reconsideration of the drug's rare disease status and a pharmacy voucher program have drawn scrutiny, highlighting tensions between regulatory processes and political influence.
  • MoAs: Tzield is an anti-CD3 monoclonal antibody that modulates the immune system to delay the onset of type 1 diabetes by preserving pancreatic beta-cell function.
  • Sources: STAT News, BioSpace, STAT News (Pharmalot)
